result: At pinned modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, RequestMetaObject decoding and Streamable HTTP pre-dispatch validation do not enforce equality of well-typed per-request protocolVersion/clientCapabilities against previously initialized peer context. ProtocolVersion accepts any JSON string; ClientCapabilities accepts different structurally valid objects. Streamable HTTP requires request protocolVersion to match the same request's MCP-Protocol-Version header and may require well-typed metadata, but does not compare those values to prior peer_info. Metadata-bearing HTTP requests are routed through direct per-request negotiation with peer_info reconstructed from the request header rather than the earlier handshake; generic non-HTTP serve_inner remains covered by the prior no-consistency-gate finding.
